1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.description: Bonus action: buff an ally's next attack roll (d6, scales with level).

1.name: Vicious Mockery
1.description: Cantrip: WIS save, psychic damage + disadvantage on target's next attack.

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.description: Add half proficiency to ability checks that don't already include it. Non-combat in this sim.

2.name: Song of Rest
2.description: Extra healing during a short rest. Non-combat.

2.name: Healing Word
2.description: 1st level, bonus action: 1d4+mod HP when an ally is below 35%.

3.name: Bard College
3.description: Choose subclass. Non-combat in this sim except where a subclass feature is listed below.

3.name: Expertise
3.description: Double proficiency on two skills. Non-combat.

3.name: Hold Person
3.description: 2nd level: WIS save or paralyzed; save again each turn.

5.name: Font of Inspiration
5.description: Bardic Inspiration recharges on a short rest. Not simulated -- rest cycles aren't modeled mid-combat; uses stay at CHA-mod per combat.

6.name: Countercharm
6.description: Advantage vs. frightened/charmed for nearby allies. Non-combat in this sim.

10.name: Expertise
10.description: Double proficiency on two more skills. Non-combat.

14.name: Magical Secrets
14.description: Learn two spells from any class. Not simulated -- would require ad-hoc spell selection at build time.

18.name: Magical Secrets
18.description: Learn two more spells from any class. Not simulated.

20.name: Superior Inspiration
20.description: Regain one Bardic Inspiration use when you roll initiative with none left. Non-combat in this sim.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: Reaction: subtract a Bardic Inspiration die from an enemy's attack/damage/check. Not simulated -- would need roll-interception aimed at enemies, deferred.

6.name: Additional Magical Secrets
6.description: Learn two spells from any class. Not simulated.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: Add Bardic Inspiration to your own failed ability check. Non-combat.

3.name: Combat Inspiration
3.description: Bardic Inspiration die can also boost damage or AC. Folded into Bardic Inspiration's flat EV bonus in this sim.

3.name: Armor Proficiencies
3.description: Medium armor, shields, martial weapons. Non-combat in this sim (no melee-build support authored yet).

14.name: Battle Magic
14.description: Bonus action attack after casting a bard spell. Not simulated.
